cronjobs.description:
A map of CronJobs to render alongside (or instead of) the Deployment. It's a map rather than a list so downstream values files can override a single cronjob's fields (e.g. `cronjobs.cleanup.schedule`) without having to redefine the whole list - Helm only deep-merges maps, not lists.
The map key also becomes a suffix on the CronJob's name (`<fullname>-<key>`), except for the reserved key `default`, which renders with no suffix - use that key for the common case of a single cronjob.
Each entry may override `schedule`, `successfulJobsHistoryLimit`, `executable`, and `executableArgs` independently of the Deployment/other cronjobs; unset fields fall back to the top-level values.
`podAnnotations` on an entry are added on top of the top-level `podAnnotations` (and any vault agent annotations), taking precedence on conflicting keys - e.g. to set `vault.hashicorp.com/agent-pre-populate-only: "true"` only for a cronjob while the Deployment keeps the vault agent sidecar running.
